introHtml: Safety carpenter pencils combine the durability of traditional carpenter pencils with high-visibility colors that improve tool identification and reduce loss on busy job sites. Available in bright safety hues, these pencils are ideal for construction crews, maintenance teams, and utility workers who need reliable marking tools that stand out. Custom imprint your company logo on the flat body for effective branding that stays visible even in dusty conditions.
